program.source: export function evaluate({ inputs, time }) { const launchSpeed = inputs.launchSpeed ?? 4; const gravity = inputs.gravity ?? 9.8; const mass = inputs.mass ?? 1.0; const t = Math.max(0, time); const velocity = launchSpeed - gravity * t; const height = launchSpeed * t - 0.5 * gravity * t * t; const acceleration = -gravity; const force = mass * gravity; const apexTime = launchSpeed / gravity; const apexHeight = (launchSpeed * launchSpeed) / (2 * gravity); let motionState = "Rising"; if (t === 0) { motionState = "Ready to toss"; } else if (Math.abs(velocity) < 0.05) { motionState = "At the top"; } else if (velocity < 0) { motionState = height <= 0 ? "Back at launch height" : "Falling"; } if (height < 0) { motionState = "Back at launch height"; } const objects = []; objects.push(...sdk.panel({ x: 20, y: 30, w: 280, h: 330, title: "The Motion", state: motionState })); objects.push(sdk.axis("axis.y", { x: 50, y: 320, length: 240, orientation: "y", min: 0, max: 2.2, ticks: [0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0], label: "Height", unit: "m" })); const ballY = 320 - Math.min(2.2, Math.max(0, height)) * (240 / 2.2); objects.push(sdk.circle("ball.toss", 160, ballY, 24, { role: "output" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.v", { x: 160, y: ballY }, { value: velocity, direction: "up" }, { scale: 15, label: "v", role: "output" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.a", { x: 190, y: ballY }, { value: acceleration, direction: "up" }, { scale: 5, label: "a", role: "output" })); objects.push(...sdk.callout(210, ballY - 20, ["v: " + sdk.format(velocity, 2) + " m/s", "a: " + sdk.format(acceleration, 1) + " m/s^2", "Fg: " + sdk.format(force, 1) + " N"], { id: "callout.toss" })); const points = []; const stepCount = 20; for (let i = 0; i <= stepCount; i++) { const st = (i / stepCount) * Math.max(t, apexTime * 2); const sv = launchSpeed - gravity * st; const sx = (st / (apexTime * 2)) * 260; const sy = 120 - sv * 10; points.push([sx, sy]); } objects.push(sdk.plot("plot.vt", { x: 330, y: 30, w: 290, h: 330, axes: { x: { label: "Time", min: 0, max: Math.max(1.8, apexTime * 2), unit: "s" }, y: { label: "Velocity", min: -5.5, max: 5.5, unit: "m/s" } }, series: [{ label: "v(t)", kind: "line", points: sdk.sample((st) => launchSpeed - gravity * st, 0, Math.max(1.8, apexTime * 2), 20).map(([st, sv]) => ({ x: st, y: sv })) }] })); const readouts = [{ id: "velocity", value: velocity }, { id: "acceleration", value: acceleration }, { id: "force", value: force }, { id: "motionState", value: motionState }]; return { frame: { width: 640, height: 420, objects, readouts }, quantities: { launchSpeed, gravity, mass, apexTime, apexHeight, height, velocity, acceleration, force } }; }

manifest.title: Zero velocity. Nonzero acceleration.
manifest.summary: At the top, velocity is zero, but acceleration remains -g and gravitational force is mg.
manifest.description: Two panels show a vertical toss and its velocity-time graph. A ball moves up and down on a height ruler alongside live vectors and readouts.
assumptions: No air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. Compare readings at the top.
